deep_pfn.title: Deeper point MLP
deep_pfn.hypothesis: Pointwise nonlinear depth may improve geometry encoding without spatial interactions.
deep_pfn.configuration: Append Linear64→64 (no bias), pointwise LayerNorm eps1e-3 and ReLU after the original Linear9→64/BN/ReLU; keep max pooling and64-channel output.
deep_pfn.attribution: Extra depth retains the original padded BN/max policy; do not attribute gains to masking.

context_pfn.title: Contextual pillar encoder
context_pfn.hypothesis: A point may benefit from its pillar-wide geometric context before pooling.
context_pfn.configuration: Compute valid-point max and mean of64 features; broadcast128-channel context; concatenate192 channels; Linear192→64/pointwiseLN/ReLU; masked max.
context_pfn.attribution: Compare with masked_pfn to isolate the pooling-mask change. BN still includes padding during training.

residual_bev.title: Residual BEV CNN
residual_bev.hypothesis: Identity paths may improve spatial optimization without adding parameters.
residual_bev.configuration: Keep original downsampling/upbranches; wrap each same-width stride1 Conv/GN/ReLU unit as ReLU(x+unit(x)).
residual_bev.attribution: Minimal residual adaptation, not a reproduction of ResNet. Parameters and detection lattice match baseline.

retain64.title: 64 points per pillar
retain64.hypothesis: The32-point cap may discard useful measurements.
retain64.configuration: Keep0.25m grid and20k pillars; increase per-pillar point cap32→64; regenerate observations/centroids, preserve byte-identical native targets.
retain64.attribution: Seeded within-pillar samples can differ. Point statistics/padding change along with retained measurements.

masked_pfn.title: Masked pillar pooling
masked_pfn.hypothesis: Padded slots may distort the pooled representation.
masked_pfn.configuration: Keep originalLinear/BN/ReLU; exclude invalid slots only in final maximum.
masked_pfn.attribution: BN still includes padded slots during training. Evaluation padding-extension invariance is required.

window_bev.title: Coarse BEV window attention
window_bev.hypothesis: Learned spatial interactions may improve the coarsest BEV features.
window_bev.attribution: Compare coarse_mlp; parameter matching is not FLOP matching. No shift, FFN, dropout or global attention.

coarse_mlp.title: Equal-parameter convolution control
coarse_mlp.hypothesis: Added coarse-stage capacity may explain an apparent attention gain.
coarse_mlp.attribution: Exactly262656 added parameters, equal to window_bev. Report actual time/memory; compute is not matched.

all_pillars.title: All occupied pillars in the fixture
all_pillars.hypothesis: Pillar truncation may remove all measurements from small objects.
all_pillars.configuration: Keep32 points; raise pillar cap20k→30k, covering all26384 occupied pillars in the current fixed frame.
all_pillars.attribution: Only this fixture has all-pillar coverage. Removing the sampling draw changes subsequent seeded point samples; target arrays remain byte-identical.

ragged_pillars.title: Ragged dynamic pillars
ragged_pillars.hypothesis: Removing the per-pillar point cutoff may improve support and avoid padding artifacts.
ragged_pillars.configuration: Retain all points within selected pillars, use segmented centroid/reduction with source-index lineage; keep pillar-cap removal separate.
ragged_pillars.attribution: Pin normalization axes, segmented gradients and resource behavior before implementation; compare fixed packing when caps do not bind.

grid_fine.title: Fine0.125m grouping
grid_fine.hypothesis: Finer XY cells may preserve small-object geometry.
grid_fine.configuration: Keep128mROI;1024² input grid; first study preserves physical0.5m detection-head spacing and anchor templates.
grid_fine.attribution: Exact downsampling topology is not yet frozen. Track truncation changes; input resolution and head resolution are different experiments.

grid_coarse.title: Coarse0.5m grouping
grid_coarse.hypothesis: Coarser cells may reduce computation without sacrificing useful geometry.
grid_coarse.configuration: Keep128mROI;256² input grid; preserve physical0.5m head spacing in first study.
grid_coarse.attribution: Pin stride/downsampling changes before execution; increased point truncation may offset lower spatial cost.

point_attention.title: Within-pillar attention
point_attention.hypothesis: Relative point-to-point interactions may improve summaries of local shape.
point_attention.configuration: Use relativeXYZ, valid-token masks and invariant pooling, retaining64 output channels.
point_attention.attribution: Freeze depth/width/head count and an appropriate MLP control before implementation; test padding and point-order behavior.

range_fusion.title: Range-view features into pillars
range_fusion.hypothesis: Sensor-neighborhood context may complement metric pillar geometry.
range_fusion.configuration: Encode range images; gather features by laser/return/row/column and retained source index; concatenate before pillar pooling.
range_fusion.attribution: Existing native prototype is not trained architecture admission. Preserve both returns and original point/projection identities; no semantic-target leakage.

sparse_bev_transformer.title: Sparse spatial transformer
sparse_bev_transformer.hypothesis: Occupied spatial tokens may support broader context at controlled cost.
sparse_bev_transformer.configuration: Separate sparse token/set indexing and metric position from detection export; DSVT is a research anchor.
sparse_bev_transformer.attribution: Exact topology and sparse-backbone interface remain to be specified. Do not equate this with generic dense ViT replacement.
